description:
Live battery monitoring for wireless mice, keyboards, headsets and controllers on Windows.

Battery Hub reads the battery level of wireless HID peripherals — mice, keyboards, headsets and game controllers — and shows them on a single dashboard with a per-device indicator in the system tray and low-battery notifications. Devices with no known protocol can be set up through a guided calibration wizard that identifies which byte of the HID report carries the battery level, so support is not limited to a fixed list of models. Runs entirely locally and collects no user data.
The biggest device update yet: about 25 new devices and families, found by digging through makers' own apps and open-source drivers. Thank you to everyone who sent a device report!
New devices
- MCHOSE V9 Pro 2 headset and A7 V2 Pro mouse
- Akko 8K receivers, plus Telink mice and Wobkey keyboards on the same platform
- VGN Dragonfly 3 MasterGT and other VGN mice
- LAMZU TACHI, INCA, Maya, PARO, THORN, Atlantis OG and Mini
- Rapoo VT7 and VT9 Pro / VT3 MAX
- AJAZZ AJ159 APEX, AJ179 PRO and other mice and keyboards on YICHIP receivers
- BY Tech mice such as the PIAO 8K and EWEADN S9
- ASUS ROG Claymore II keyboard, Gladius III AimPoint and the ROG OMNI receiver
- MSI VERSA 300 Elite
- Bloody R73 Pro and other Bloody wireless mice
- Darmoshark M3 and other Darmoshark mice
- AULA and EWEADN keyboards on their 2.4G receiver
- Waizowl OGM 8K
- Corsair Void Wireless v2 on its cable
- Nintendo Switch Pro Controllers, their clones and Joy-Cons over Bluetooth
- ELECOM BlueLED Mouse over Bluetooth (by @rurute)
- 2.4G mice on the 1EA7 receiver
- Bluetooth mice and keyboards whose battery Windows doesn't show are now asked for it directly
Most of these were built from the makers' own software and weren't tested on real hardware here, so please tell us how yours does.

New
- Several devices on one Logitech receiver each get their own card (by @rurute).

Fixed
- Redragon M901P-KS, M913 and VSG Aquila Fly receivers that still failed in 2.0.7.
- MCHOSE X9 now reads while charging or full, and shows when it's asleep.
- The check no longer says "Couldn't reach GitHub to compare" when GitHub limits the network.
Thanks to @rurute for the contributions in this release.
